Myth: 1000 subscribers hue, paise shuru.
Fact: YouTube Partner Programme mein subscribers ke saath 4,000 watch hours ya Shorts ke 1 crore views (90 din mein) bhi chahiye.
Pehle YouTube Help mein latest rules check karo.
Aapke kitne subscribers hain abhi? Comment mein batao 👇
